name: Enterprise Fund Committee Special Meeting Agenda 10-8-2019
agenda_text:
CITY OF EL MONTE

  SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
  ENTERPRISE FUND COMMITTEE
  OCTOBER 8, 2019 – 6:00 p.m.
  El Monte City Hall West – Conference Room A
  11333 Valley Boulevard El Monte, California

1.  CALL TO ORDER

2.  ROLL CALL

3.  FLAG SALUTE

4.  APPROVAL OF AGENDA

5.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  Special Meeting Minutes of September 11, 2019

6.  COMMITTEE BUSINESS AND DISCUSSION ITEMS

  Members of the public will be afforded an opportunity to comment and ask questions
  on each of the agenda items below but shall be limited to two (2) minutes per person.

  A.  Presentation of the completed Water Rate Study.
  B.  Discussion and requests to submit Water Rate Study to City Counsel.
  C.  Discussion of the following request into upcoming CIP and operations update:

    005 Sewer CIP – Meeting with IEC, report showing excessive lead levels in
  the first 6” of soil indicating 1.5’ of topsoil hazardous waste disposal for a
  significant amount of the 140 laterals to be replaced. Determined the need for
  scope of work to assess lateral access and construction needed for lateral
  installation.

    Payment for Sewer truck ($115,000) – Original requisition approval on
  09/2016. Invoice not submitted until 2017 under wrong vendor name.
  Requested for change – not reconciled until July 2018. Must resubmit to
  counsel.

    Water Meter replacement complete – need to assess plans for additional
  failures.

  7.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATIONS

  8.  ADJOURN MEETING

  Agenda Posted: October 3, 2019
